title: CTRES v1.0 R6 Internal Movement
description: Movements between the operator's own funds locations (settlement from a provider to a bank, sweeps, tax remittance), which is where segregation either holds or breaks (§4.6).

source_location_id.x-ctres-condition: Exactly one of source_location_id or source_provider_id is present; at least one side of the movement is a location in R1 (§4.6).

source_provider_id.description: Source provider, from R10, where the source is not a location in R1, for example an exchange or a settlement account (§4.6).
source_provider_id.x-ctres-condition: Exactly one of source_location_id or source_provider_id is present; at least one side of the movement is a location in R1 (§4.6).

destination_location_id.x-ctres-condition: Exactly one of destination_location_id or destination_provider_id is present; at least one side of the movement is a location in R1 (§4.6).

destination_provider_id.description: Destination provider, from R10, where the destination is not a location in R1 (§4.6).
destination_provider_id.x-ctres-condition: Exactly one of destination_location_id or destination_provider_id is present; at least one side of the movement is a location in R1 (§4.6).

crosses_purpose_class.description: Whether the movement crosses purpose classes (§4.6). Validation may recompute it from R1.

executed_at.description: When the movement was executed on the rail (§4.6).

rail_reference.description: Identifier the rail issued for the movement (§4.6).

rail_reference_type.description: Kind of identifier carried in rail_reference (§4.6; §4.3).

currency_or_asset.description: Currency or asset of the amount (§4.6; §3 Currency-aware).

fees.description: Fees borne on the movement, separated (§4.6).
